context: Tests whether the frontend dev skill makes the agent recommend schema-driven parsing, explicit state modeling, and repo verification for a bug-sensitive UI flow.

checklist.name: parses_unknown_at_boundary
checklist.description: Recommends parsing unknown API JSON at the boundary with the repo's schema/parser approach before passing typed values into UI code.

checklist.name: models_transfer_states_explicitly
checklist.description: Recommends discriminated unions, exhaustive handling, or a state machine for transfer statuses instead of optional-field or boolean-salad state.

checklist.name: rejects_type_escape_hatches
checklist.description: Explicitly avoids `as` casts, non-null assertions, and loosely typed validated data as the solution to the draft component's problems.

checklist.name: uses_repo_local_patterns_first
checklist.description: Says to inspect AGENTS.md, README.md, and existing `.patterns/` or code precedent before applying default put.io patterns.

checklist.name: includes_verification_plan
checklist.description: Names an appropriate verification path, including the repo verify command and a browser/device exercise for the UI behavior.
